en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s four-day event at Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park will feature more than 340 booths from about 31 countries and regions.
body: The Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival will return from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said.

Organised by the board and co-organised by the Bordeaux wine council, this year’s edition is themed “Taste the World’s Best”. It will have more than 340 booths, an increase of over 10 percent from last year, presenting wines and food from about 31 countries and regions. New pavilions from Australia, Canada and South Korea are among the additions.

Opening hours run from 7:30pm to midnight on the first day, 1pm to 1am on Friday and Saturday, and 1pm to midnight on the final Sunday. The board said the event will be followed by Hong Kong Gourmet Month throughout November.

Admission tickets are available, with concessions for seniors, children and students. The organisers said visitors can sample global vintages alongside local and international dishes against the harbour backdrop.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餐巡禮10月29日起於中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動設逾340個攤位，匯聚約31個國家及地區的美酒美食，周五六開放至凌晨1時。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，年度旗艦盛事「香港美酒佳餐巡禮」將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行。
今年以「品味世界之最」為主題，由旅發局主辦、波爾多葡萄酒行業協會協辦。攤位數目超過340個，較去年增加逾一成，匯聚約31個國家及地區的美酒佳餐，並有澳洲、加拿大及南韓等新設館。
開放時間方面，首日晚上7時30分至午夜，周五及周六下午1時至凌晨1時，周日下午1時至午夜。活動結束後，11月將推出「香港美食月」。
入場券設有長者、兒童及學生優惠。主辦方指，訪客可在維港景觀下品嘗環球佳醷及各地美食。
